text:
amy: Heads-up — sampleapp embed batching is doing something weird. When I enable windowed batching + paginator prefetch, some embed requests get double-sent and we hit client-side quota spikes.

sam: @amy can you paste the SDK config and which sdk version?

amy: js-sdk@2.7.1 (npm). Config I'm using below — small sample from sampleapp flags: 
```json
{
  "batcher": { "windowMs": 60, "maxBatchTokens": 2048 },
  "paginator": { "prefetch": 2, "cursorMode": "optimistic" }
}
```

mike_r: Do you see 429s coming back from the API or are these client aborts / duplicate sends?

amy: Mostly 429s from the API, but the client log shows duplicate POSTs for the same payload id — looks like a retry backoff fires while the paginator prefetch still schedules the same page. Route is /v1/embeddings/batch in our repro.

rajiv: Is this limited to embeddings flows? Any tokenization differences or caching enabled?

amy: Not using prefix caching. Repro steps: start sampleapp with 10 parallel simulated users, page size 25, request 100 items each, prefetch=2. After ~30s you see some items processed twice and quotas spike.

sam: Can you share truncated client + server logs (request ids) so we can correlate?

amy: pasted minimal logs below (client timestamps removed):
```
CLIENT: send req=abc123 payloadHash=0x9f3
SERVER: 429 svc-req=svc-zz-456 quota-exceeded
CLIENT: retry backoff sending req=abc123 (attempt=2)
CLIENT: send req=abc123 payloadHash=0x9f3
SERVER: 200 svc-req=svc-zz-457 processed=25
```

ci-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy 2026-03-15 09:02 succeeded :rocket:

mike_r: Looks familiar — I remember a change in js-sdk 2.7 where retries were moved earlier in the request lifecycle when optimistic cursor mode is enabled. That can cause the paginator prefetch to think the in-flight slot failed and requeue the same page. Can someone open a GH issue with a minimal repro?

amy: Filed issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/issues/412 — included a tiny repro (sampleapp flags + script) and the logs above. cc @sam @mike_r

sam: Thanks. Short-term mitigation: set paginator.prefetch=1 or disable cursorMode: "optimistic" in sampleapp. We should patch 2.8 to mark items in-flight before any client-side retry scheduler re-emits them.

amy: Confirmed workaround: prefetch=1 eliminates duplicates in my runs. Leaving repro notes in the GH issue and sampleapp config.

mike_r: I'll pick this up for the 2.8 patch and add an integration test for concurrent prefetch + retry so it doesn't regress.

amy: Thanks all! :pray:
